title: paperclipai/paperclip
title_zh: 开源工作用AI代理管理应用 Paperclip

paragraphs.en: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
paragraphs.zh: 所有人用来在工作中管理智能体的开源应用

paragraphs.en: Quickstart · Docs · GitHub · Discord · Twitter · Website
paragraphs.zh: 快速入门 · 文档 · GitHub · Discord · Twitter · 网站

paragraphs.en: Sign up for the Paperclip Cloud waitlist →
paragraphs.zh: 注册 Paperclip Cloud 候补名单 →

paragraphs.en: Open-source orchestration for teams of AI agents.
paragraphs.zh: 面向 AI 智能体团队的开源编排工具。

paragraphs.en: If OpenClaw is an employee , Paperclip is the company .
paragraphs.zh: 如果 OpenClaw 是一名员工，那么 Paperclip 就是这家公司。

paragraphs.en: Paperclip is a Node.js server and React UI that orchestrates a team of AI agents to run a business. Bring your own agents, assign goals, and track work and costs from one dashboard. Choose models and harnesses per agent while keeping your team's tasks, skills, permissions, and history in one place.
paragraphs.zh: Paperclip 是一个 Node.js 服务器和 React UI，用于编排一个由 AI 智能体组成的团队来经营一项业务。 带上你自己的智能体，设定目标，并在一个仪表板中跟踪工作进展和成本。 可为每个智能体选择模型和工具框架，同时将你团队的任务、技能、权限和历史记录集中在一处管理。

paragraphs.en: Four things have to work for an organization of AI agents to actually produce: the tasks, the org, the training, and the infrastructure. Paperclip is built around exactly those four pillars.
paragraphs.zh: 一个由 AI 智能体组成的组织要真正产出，有四件事必须有效运转：任务、组织、训练和基础设施。 Paperclip 正是围绕这四大支柱构建的。

sents.en: Four things have to work for an organization of AI agents to actually produce: the tasks, the org, the training, and the infrastructure.
sents.zh: 一个由 AI 智能体组成的组织要真正产出，有四件事必须有效运转：任务、组织、训练和基础设施。

sents.en: Paperclip is built around exactly those four pillars.
sents.zh: Paperclip 正是围绕这四大支柱构建的。

paragraphs.en: Pillar Built for What it covers Agentic Task Manager — Declare intent. Agents work. You verify the output. Everyone, daily Tasks, approvals & review gates · proactive agent coworkers · auditable routines & workflows · verify from diffs, screenshots & tests Org Chart for Agents — Roles, permissions & boundaries for humans and agents. Managers Mixed human + agent org chart · responsibilities, delegation, specialization · governance: who can do what · scoped secrets & company boundaries · connection permissions & responsible-user identities Agent Employee Training — Design, train & evaluate your AI employees. Enablers Skill Studio & shared org-wide skills · evals & saved test runs · active learning loops & quality metrics · performance reviews for agents · saved test inputs · skill version history & restore · reusable team templates Agentic OS — The infrastructure that makes the work run. IT & platform Cross-provider runtime: any model, any agent · sandboxing, integrations & MCP servers · SSO, GRC, RBAC & cost controls · data privacy, internal trace collection, compounding data value · personal & shared app connections · run history & opt-in tracing Features 🔌 Bring Your Own Agent Any agent, any runtime, one org chart. If it can receive a heartbeat, it's hired. 🎯 Goal Alignment Link tasks and projects to your organization goals. Agents receive the goal context behind their work. 💓 Heartbeats Agents wake for assigned work, follow-up messages, or configured schedules. Delegation flows up and down the org chart. 💰 Cost Control Company, agent, and project budgets . Track reported spend, get threshold alerts, and pause work at configured limits. 🏢 Multi-Organization One deployment, many organizations. Separate tasks, agents, permissions, and activity histories for each. 🎫 Task Threads Keep conversations, plans, blockers, files, and run history attached to the work. Assign tasks to agents or people. 🛡️ Governance Configure review and approval stages , approve hires, and pause, reassign, or stop work when needed. 📊 Org Chart Hierarchies, roles, reporting lines. Your agents have a boss, a title, and a job description. 📱 Mobile Ready Monitor and manage your autonomous businesses from anywhere. 🔗 Apps & Connections Connect services such as GitHub, Notion, and Railway, or your own MCP server. Set gateway actions to Allowed, Ask first, or Off. 👥 Shared Agents, Personal Accounts Choose who can use a connection and which agents can access it .
paragraphs.zh: 核心支柱 适用范围 智能体任务管理器 —— 声明意图。智能体工作。你验证输出。 所有人，每天 任务、审批与评审关卡 · 主动式智能体同事 · 可审计的例程与工作流 · 通过差异、截图与测试进行验证 智能体组织架构图 —— 为人类与智能体设定角色、权限与边界。 管理者 人类与智能体混合的组织架构图 · 职责、授权与专业化 · 治理：谁可以做什么 · 范围受限的密钥与公司边界 · 连接权限与责任用户身份 智能体员工培训 —— 设计、训练并评估你的 AI 员工。 赋能者 技能工作室与全组织共享技能 · 评估与已保存的测试运行 · 主动学习循环与质量指标 · 智能体绩效评估 · 已保存的测试输入 · 技能版本历史与恢复 · 可复用的团队模板 智能体操作系统 —— 让工作运转起来的基础设施。 IT 与平台 跨提供商运行时：任意模型、任意智能体 · 沙箱、集成与 MCP 服务器 · SSO、GRC、RBAC 与成本控制 · 数据隐私、内部轨迹收集、数据价值的持续积累 · 个人与共享应用连接 · 运行历史与可选开启的追踪 功能 🔌 带你自己的智能体 任意智能体，任意运行时，一张组织架构图。 只要它能接收心跳，它就算被录用了。 🎯 目标对齐 将任务与项目关联到你的组织目标。 智能体在其工作背后会收到目标上下文。 💓 心跳 智能体会因被分配的工作、后续消息或配置的日程而唤醒。 授权在组织架构图中自上而下、自下而上流动。 💰 成本控制 公司、智能体与项目预算。 跟踪上报的支出，接收阈值警报，并在达到配置的限额时暂停工作。 🏢 多组织 一次部署，多个组织。 为每个组织单独隔离任务、智能体、权限与活动历史。 🎫 任务会话 让对话、计划、阻碍、文件与运行历史附着在工作上。 将任务分配给智能体或人员。 🛡️ 治理 配置评审与审批阶段，批准录用，并在需要时暂停、重新分配或停止工作。 📊 组织架构图 层级、角色与汇报关系。 你的智能体有老板、头衔和职位描述。 📱 移动端就绪 随时随地监控和管理你的自主业务。 🔗 应用与连接 连接 GitHub、Notion、Railway 等服务，或你自己的 MCP 服务器。 将网关操作设置为允许、先询问或关闭。 👥 共享智能体、个人账户 选择谁可以使用某个连接，以及哪些智能体可以访问它。

paragraphs.en: Managed GitHub operations can use the account of the person directing the work. 🧠 Skills & Skill Studio Install or write shared skills , test them with saved inputs, inspect results, and restore earlier versions. 📅 Scheduled Routines Run recurring work on a schedule or trigger it through an API or webhook. Each run has a task, an owner, and a history. 📎 Artifacts & Feedback Find the files and documents agents produce . Preview supported formats and leave comments on specific passages in documents. 📦 Ready-Made Teams Preview and install teams with roles, skills, projects, and routines. Choose their runtimes and make the setup your own. Experimental Agent Chat and chat/email connectors add conversations with agents in Paperclip and through configured services such as Slack, Discord, Telegram, and AgentMail. Enable the relevant instance settings to try them.
paragraphs.zh: 托管的 GitHub 操作可以使用指挥工作的人员的账户。🧠 技能与技能工作室 安装或编写共享技能，使用保存的输入进行测试，检查结果，并恢复较早的版本。📅 定时例程 按计划运行周期性工作，或通过 API 或 webhook 触发。 每次运行都有任务、负责人和历史记录。📎 产物与反馈 查找智能体生成的文件和文档。 预览支持的格式，并针对文档中的特定段落发表评论。📦 现成团队 预览并安装包含角色、技能、项目和例程的团队。 选择它们的运行时，并使配置符合你自己的需求。 实验性功能 智能体聊天以及聊天/邮件连接器，可在 Paperclip 中以及通过配置的服务（如 Slack、Discord、Telegram 和 AgentMail）与智能体进行对话。 启用相关的实例设置即可试用它们。

paragraphs.en: Work & Task System — Issues carry company/project/goal/parent links, atomic checkout with execution locks, first-class blocker dependencies, comments, documents, attachments, work products, labels, and inbox state. sents.en: Work & Task System — Issues carry company/project/goal/parent links, atomic checkout with execution locks, first-class blocker dependencies, comments, documents, attachments, work products, labels, and inbox state.
sents.zh: 工作与任务系统 — Issue 携带公司/项目/目标/父级关联，支持带执行锁的原子化 checkout、一流的阻塞依赖、评论、文档、附件、工作产物、标签以及收件箱状态。

sents.en: Search across work, review document revisions, and leave anchored feedback.
sents.zh: 跨工作内容进行搜索，审阅文档修订版本，并留下锚定反馈。

paragraphs.en: Heartbeat Execution — DB-backed wakeup queue with coalescing, budget checks, workspace resolution, secret injection, skill loading, and adapter invocation. Runs produce logs, usage records, and adapter-specific session state. Bounded recovery handles supported failures and surfaces cases that need human action.
paragraphs.zh: 心跳执行——基于数据库的唤醒队列，支持合并、预算检查、工作区解析、密钥注入、技能加载和适配器调用。 运行会产生日志、用量记录以及适配器特定的会话状态。 有界恢复会处理受支持的故障，并上报需要人工处理的情况。

sents.en: Heartbeat Execution — DB-backed wakeup queue with coalescing, budget checks, workspace resolution, secret injection, skill loading, and adapter invocation.
sents.zh: 心跳执行——基于数据库的唤醒队列，支持合并、预算检查、工作区解析、密钥注入、技能加载和适配器调用。

sents.en: Runs produce logs, usage records, and adapter-specific session state.
sents.zh: 运行会产生日志、用量记录以及适配器特定的会话状态。

sents.en: Bounded recovery handles supported failures and surfaces cases that need human action.
sents.zh: 有界恢复会处理受支持的故障，并上报需要人工处理的情况。

paragraphs.en: Workspaces & Runtime — Project repositories and workspaces, optional isolated execution workspaces (git worktrees, operator branches), and runtime services (dev servers, preview URLs). Sandbox providers extend execution beyond the local host; availability depends on the configured environment and adapter.
paragraphs.zh: 工作区与运行时 — 项目仓库与工作区、可选的隔离执行工作区（git worktree、操作者分支），以及运行时服务（开发服务器、预览 URL）。 沙箱提供方将执行扩展到本地主机之外；可用性取决于所配置的环境和适配器。

sents.en: Workspaces & Runtime — Project repositories and workspaces, optional isolated execution workspaces (git worktrees, operator branches), and runtime services (dev servers, preview URLs).
sents.zh: 工作区与运行时 — 项目仓库与工作区、可选的隔离执行工作区（git worktree、操作者分支），以及运行时服务（开发服务器、预览 URL）。

sents.en: Sandbox providers extend execution beyond the local host; availability depends on the configured environment and adapter.
sents.zh: 沙箱提供方将执行扩展到本地主机之外；可用性取决于所配置的环境和适配器。

paragraphs.en: Governance & Approvals — Board approval workflows, execution policies with review/approval stages, decision tracking, budget hard-stops, and agent pause/resume/terminate. Configured task reviews govern completion; connection action approvals govern calls through the tool gateway.
paragraphs.zh: 治理与审批 — 董事会审批工作流、带审核/审批阶段的执行策略、决策追踪、预算硬性中止，以及智能体的暂停/恢复/终止。 已配置的任务审核控制完成流程；连接操作审批控制通过工具网关发起的调用。

sents.en: Governance & Approvals — Board approval workflows, execution policies with review/approval stages, decision tracking, budget hard-stops, and agent pause/resume/terminate.
sents.zh: 治理与审批 — 董事会审批工作流、带审核/审批阶段的执行策略、决策追踪、预算硬性中止，以及智能体的暂停/恢复/终止。

sents.en: Configured task reviews govern completion; connection action approvals govern calls through the tool gateway.
sents.zh: 已配置的任务审核控制完成流程；连接操作审批控制通过工具网关发起的调用。

paragraphs.en: Budget & Cost Control — Token and cost tracking by company, agent, project, goal, issue, provider, and model. Scoped budget policies with warning thresholds and hard stops. Enforcement uses recorded spend; usage reporting and in-flight work can delay a stop.
paragraphs.zh: 预算与成本控制 — 按公司、智能体、项目、目标、议题、提供商和模型跟踪令牌用量与成本。 支持带告警阈值和硬性停止的范围化预算策略。 强制执行依据已记录的支出；用量上报与进行中的工作可能延迟停止。

sents.en: Budget & Cost Control — Token and cost tracking by company, agent, project, goal, issue, provider, and model.
sents.zh: 预算与成本控制 — 按公司、智能体、项目、目标、议题、提供商和模型跟踪令牌用量与成本。

sents.en: Scoped budget policies with warning thresholds and hard stops.
sents.zh: 支持带告警阈值和硬性停止的范围化预算策略。

sents.en: Enforcement uses recorded spend; usage reporting and in-flight work can delay a stop.
sents.zh: 强制执行依据已记录的支出；用量上报与进行中的工作可能延迟停止。

paragraphs.en: Routines & Schedules — Recurring tasks with cron, webhook, and API triggers. Concurrency and catch-up policies. Each routine execution creates a tracked issue and wakes the assigned agent — no manual kick-offs needed.
paragraphs.zh: 例程与日程 — 支持通过 cron、webhook 和 API 触发器执行周期性任务。 并发与补跑策略。 每次例程执行都会创建一个可追踪的问题并唤醒指定的智能体——无需手动启动。

sents.en: Routines & Schedules — Recurring tasks with cron, webhook, and API triggers.
sents.zh: 例程与日程 — 支持通过 cron、webhook 和 API 触发器执行周期性任务。

sents.en: Concurrency and catch-up policies.
sents.zh: 并发与补跑策略。

sents.en: Each routine execution creates a tracked issue and wakes the assigned agent — no manual kick-offs needed.
sents.zh: 每次例程执行都会创建一个可追踪的问题并唤醒指定的智能体——无需手动启动。

paragraphs.en: Plugins — Instance-wide plugin system with out-of-process workers, capability-gated host services, job scheduling, tool exposure, and UI contributions. Extend Paperclip without forking it.
paragraphs.zh: 插件 — 实例级的插件系统，支持进程外工作进程、按能力门控的宿主服务、任务调度、工具暴露以及 UI 扩展点。 无需分叉（fork）Paperclip 即可对其进行扩展。

sents.en: Plugins — Instance-wide plugin system with out-of-process workers, capability-gated host services, job scheduling, tool exposure, and UI contributions.
sents.zh: 插件 — 实例级的插件系统，支持进程外工作进程、按能力门控的宿主服务、任务调度、工具暴露以及 UI 扩展点。

sents.en: Extend Paperclip without forking it.
sents.zh: 无需分叉（fork）Paperclip 即可对其进行扩展。

paragraphs.en: Secrets & Storage — Company secrets and per-person secret values, encrypted credential storage, local or S3-compatible file storage, attachments, and work products. Secret references supply credentials to authorized runs without copying values into ordinary agent configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 机密与存储 — 公司机密和个人机密值、加密的凭据存储、本地或兼容 S3 的文件存储、附件及工作成果。 机密引用可为已授权的运行提供凭据，而无需将值复制到普通的智能体配置中。

sents.en: Secrets & Storage — Company secrets and per-person secret values, encrypted credential storage, local or S3-compatible file storage, attachments, and work products.
sents.zh: 机密与存储 — 公司机密和个人机密值、加密的凭据存储、本地或兼容 S3 的文件存储、附件及工作成果。

sents.en: Secret references supply credentials to authorized runs without copying values into ordinary agent configuration.
sents.zh: 机密引用可为已授权的运行提供凭据，而无需将值复制到普通的智能体配置中。

paragraphs.en: Activity & Events — Mutating actions, heartbeat state changes, cost events, approvals, comments, and work products are recorded as durable activity so operators can audit what happened and why.
paragraphs.zh: 活动与事件 — 变更类操作、心跳状态变化、成本事件、审批、评论以及工作成果都会被记录为持久化的活动，以便运维人员能够审计发生了什么以及为什么发生。

paragraphs.en: Company Portability — Preview, export, and import organization packages with agents, skills, and optional projects, routines, tasks, and attachments. Referenced secret values are omitted; review packages before sharing because plain environment values and local paths can remain. Packages share an operating setup; full-instance recovery uses backups.
paragraphs.zh: 企业可移植性 — 预览、导出和导入包含智能体、技能以及可选项目、例程、任务和附件的组织数据包。 被引用的密钥值会被省略；由于明文环境变量值和本地路径可能会保留，共享前请先审查数据包。 数据包共享的是同一套运行配置；完整实例的恢复请使用备份。

sents.en: Company Portability — Preview, export, and import organization packages with agents, skills, and optional projects, routines, tasks, and attachments.
sents.zh: 企业可移植性 — 预览、导出和导入包含智能体、技能以及可选项目、例程、任务和附件的组织数据包。

sents.en: Referenced secret values are omitted; review packages before sharing because plain environment values and local paths can remain.
sents.zh: 被引用的密钥值会被省略；由于明文环境变量值和本地路径可能会保留，共享前请先审查数据包。

sents.en: Packages share an operating setup; full-instance recovery uses backups.
sents.zh: 数据包共享的是同一套运行配置；完整实例的恢复请使用备份。

paragraphs.en: Open source. Self-hosted. No Paperclip account required. Follow the guided quickstart to set up your first agent.
paragraphs.zh: 开源。可自托管。 无需 Paperclip 账户。 按照引导式快速入门设置你的第一个智能体。

sents.en: Open source. Self-hosted.
sents.zh: 开源。可自托管。

sents.en: No Paperclip account required.
sents.zh: 无需 Paperclip 账户。

sents.en: Follow the guided quickstart to set up your first agent.
sents.zh: 按照引导式快速入门设置你的第一个智能体。

paragraphs.en: Share the installation guide with your agent.
paragraphs.zh: 与您的智能体分享安装指南。

paragraphs.en: npx paperclipai@latest onboard --yes The CLI runs from npm's cache; your instance configuration and data persist locally.
paragraphs.zh: npx paperclipai@latest onboard --yes 该 CLI 从 npm 的缓存运行；你的实例配置和数据会持久化保存在本地。

paragraphs.en: See the installation guide for managed installs, pinned versions, canary and git-ref installs, updates, rollback, service management, and uninstalling.
paragraphs.zh: 请参阅安装指南，了解托管安装、固定版本、canary 和 git-ref 安装、更新、回滚、服务管理以及卸载的相关内容。

paragraphs.en: For an isolated manual test instance that is already initialized with a CEO agent, use test-drive . It stays in the foreground, never installs a service or creates a first task, and opens the browser only after setup succeeds:
paragraphs.zh: 对于已经用 CEO 智能体完成初始化的隔离手动测试实例，请使用 test-drive。 它保持在前台运行，从不安装服务或创建第一个任务，并且只在设置成功后才打开浏览器：

sents.en: For an isolated manual test instance that is already initialized with a CEO agent, use test-drive .
sents.zh: 对于已经用 CEO 智能体完成初始化的隔离手动测试实例，请使用 test-drive。

sents.en: It stays in the foreground, never installs a service or creates a first task, and opens the browser only after setup succeeds:
sents.zh: 它保持在前台运行，从不安装服务或创建第一个任务，并且只在设置成功后才打开浏览器：

paragraphs.en: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... npx paperclipai test-drive OPENAI_API_KEY=... npx paperclipai test-drive --harness codex OPENROUTER_API_KEY=... npx paperclipai test-drive \ --harness opencode \ --model openrouter/anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5 Each run without --data-dir gets a unique, retained temporary directory; its absolute path is printed at startup. Pass --data-dir to reuse one, or --no-browser to leave the initialized instance unopened. When invoked from a linked Git worktree, test-drive also enables task execution in that worktree. See the test-drive guide for credential and reuse behavior.
paragraphs.zh: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... npx paperclipai test-drive OPENAI_API_KEY=... npx paperclipai test-drive --harness codex OPENROUTER_API_KEY=... npx paperclipai test-drive \ --harness opencode \ --model openrouter/anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5 每次不带 --data-dir 运行都会获得一个唯一的、会保留的临时目录；其绝对路径会在启动时打印出来。 传入 --data-dir 可复用同一目录，或使用 --no-browser 使已初始化的实例不被打开。 当从已链接的 Git worktree 中调用时，test-drive 还会在该 worktree 中启用任务执行。 凭证与复用行为请参阅 test-drive 指南。

sents.en: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... npx paperclipai test-drive OPENAI_API_KEY=... npx paperclipai test-drive --harness codex OPENROUTER_API_KEY=... npx paperclipai test-drive \ --harness opencode \ --model openrouter/anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5 Each run without --data-dir gets a unique, retained temporary directory; its absolute path is printed at startup.
sents.zh: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... npx paperclipai test-drive OPENAI_API_KEY=... npx paperclipai test-drive --harness codex OPENROUTER_API_KEY=... npx paperclipai test-drive \ --harness opencode \ --model openrouter/anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5 每次不带 --data-dir 运行都会获得一个唯一的、会保留的临时目录；其绝对路径会在启动时打印出来。

sents.en: Pass --data-dir to reuse one, or --no-browser to leave the initialized instance unopened.
sents.zh: 传入 --data-dir 可复用同一目录，或使用 --no-browser 使已初始化的实例不被打开。

sents.en: When invoked from a linked Git worktree, test-drive also enables task execution in that worktree.
sents.zh: 当从已链接的 Git worktree 中调用时，test-drive 还会在该 worktree 中启用任务执行。

sents.en: See the test-drive guide for credential and reuse behavior.
sents.zh: 凭证与复用行为请参阅 test-drive 指南。

paragraphs.en: Troubleshooting: private npm registry .npmrc
paragraphs.zh: 故障排除：私有 npm 仓库 .npmrc

paragraphs.en: If this fails with an E404 for paperclipai (or similar) and you use a private npm registry (for example GitHub Packages) via a global ~/.npmrc , npx may be resolving paperclipai against that private registry instead of the public npm registry.
paragraphs.zh: 如果此操作失败并出现针对 paperclipai 的 E404 错误（或类似错误），并且你通过全局 ~/.npmrc 使用私有 npm 仓库（例如 GitHub Packages），那么 npx 可能是在针对该私有仓库（而不是公共 npm 仓库）来解析 paperclipai。

paragraphs.en: npm config get registry Workaround (cross-platform; force the public npm registry for this command):
paragraphs.zh: npm config get registry 解决方法（跨平台；为此命令强制使用公共 npm 仓库）：

paragraphs.en: npx --registry https://registry.npmjs.org paperclipai@latest onboard --yes That quickstart path now defaults to trusted local loopback mode for the fastest first run. To start in authenticated/private mode instead, choose a bind preset explicitly:
paragraphs.zh: npx --registry https://registry.npmjs.org paperclipai@latest onboard --yes 这条快速上手路径现在默认使用受信任的本地回环模式，以实现最快首次运行。 若要改为以经过身份验证的/私有模式启动，请显式选择一个绑定预设：

sents.en: npx --registry https://registry.npmjs.org paperclipai@latest onboard --yes That quickstart path now defaults to trusted local loopback mode for the fastest first run.
sents.zh: npx --registry https://registry.npmjs.org paperclipai@latest onboard --yes 这条快速上手路径现在默认使用受信任的本地回环模式，以实现最快首次运行。

sents.en: To start in authenticated/private mode instead, choose a bind preset explicitly:
sents.zh: 若要改为以经过身份验证的/私有模式启动，请显式选择一个绑定预设：

paragraphs.en: npx paperclipai@latest onboard --yes --bind lan # or: npx paperclipai@latest onboard --yes --bind tailnet If you already have Paperclip configured, rerunning onboard keeps the existing config in place. Use npx paperclipai configure to edit settings.
paragraphs.zh: npx paperclipai@latest onboard --yes --bind lan # 或者：npx paperclipai@latest onboard --yes --bind tailnet 如果你已经配置过 Paperclip，重新运行 onboard 会保留现有配置。 使用 npx paperclipai configure 来编辑设置。

sents.en: npx paperclipai@latest onboard --yes --bind lan # or: npx paperclipai@latest onboard --yes --bind tailnet If you already have Paperclip configured, rerunning onboard keeps the existing config in place.
sents.zh: npx paperclipai@latest onboard --yes --bind lan # 或者：npx paperclipai@latest onboard --yes --bind tailnet 如果你已经配置过 Paperclip，重新运行 onboard 会保留现有配置。

sents.en: Use npx paperclipai configure to edit settings.
sents.zh: 使用 npx paperclipai configure 来编辑设置。

paragraphs.en: git clone https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip.git cd paperclip pnpm install pnpm dev This starts the UI and API at http://localhost:3100 . An embedded PostgreSQL database is created automatically — no setup required.
paragraphs.zh: git clone https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip.git cd paperclip pnpm install pnpm dev 这会在 http://localhost:3100 启动 UI 和 API。 一个内嵌的 PostgreSQL 数据库会自动创建——无需任何设置。

sents.en: git clone https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip.git cd paperclip pnpm install pnpm dev This starts the UI and API at http://localhost:3100 .
sents.zh: git clone https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip.git cd paperclip pnpm install pnpm dev 这会在 http://localhost:3100 启动 UI 和 API。

sents.en: An embedded PostgreSQL database is created automatically — no setup required.
sents.zh: 一个内嵌的 PostgreSQL 数据库会自动创建——无需任何设置。

paragraphs.en: Requirements: Node.js 24.11+, pnpm 9.15+
paragraphs.zh: 要求：Node.js 24.11+，pnpm 9.15+

paragraphs.en: Local Claude and Codex subscription sign-in also needs Python 3 and the corresponding provider CLI on the Paperclip host. The Docker image includes them.
paragraphs.zh: 本地 Claude 和 Codex 订阅登录还需要 Paperclip 主机上安装 Python 3 和相应的提供商 CLI。 Docker 镜像中已包含它们。

sents.en: Local Claude and Codex subscription sign-in also needs Python 3 and the corresponding provider CLI on the Paperclip host.
sents.zh: 本地 Claude 和 Codex 订阅登录还需要 Paperclip 主机上安装 Python 3 和相应的提供商 CLI。

sents.en: The Docker image includes them.
sents.zh: Docker 镜像中已包含它们。

paragraphs.en: Source development also builds the native Paperclip Runner when enabled (the self-hosted default). Install a Rust toolchain, or set PAPERCLIP_RUNNER_BINARY to a compatible prebuilt runner.
paragraphs.zh: 源码开发在启用时还会构建原生 Paperclip Runner（自托管默认项）。 安装 Rust 工具链，或将 PAPERCLIP_RUNNER_BINARY 设置为兼容的预构建 runner。

sents.en: Source development also builds the native Paperclip Runner when enabled (the self-hosted default).
sents.zh: 源码开发在启用时还会构建原生 Paperclip Runner（自托管默认项）。

sents.en: Install a Rust toolchain, or set PAPERCLIP_RUNNER_BINARY to a compatible prebuilt runner.
sents.zh: 安装 Rust 工具链，或将 PAPERCLIP_RUNNER_BINARY 设置为兼容的预构建 runner。

paragraphs.en: Q: Is this project maintained or just slop?
paragraphs.zh: 问：这个项目是在持续维护的，还是随便生成的垃圾？

paragraphs.en: A: Paperclip is maintained by the Paperclip team . We've merged over 2,700 pull requests .
paragraphs.zh: A: Paperclip 由 Paperclip 团队维护。 我们已经合并了超过 2,700 个拉取请求。

sents.en: A: Paperclip is maintained by the Paperclip team .
sents.zh: A: Paperclip 由 Paperclip 团队维护。

sents.en: We've merged over 2,700 pull requests .
sents.zh: 我们已经合并了超过 2,700 个拉取请求。

paragraphs.en: A: Locally, a single Node.js process manages an embedded Postgres and local file storage. For production, point it at your own Postgres and deploy however you like. Configure projects, agents, and goals — the agents take care of the rest.
paragraphs.zh: A: 在本地，单个 Node.js 进程管理一个嵌入式 Postgres 和本地文件存储。 在生产环境中，将其指向你自己的 Postgres，并按你喜欢的方式部署。 配置项目、智能体和目标 —— 其余的交给智能体处理。

sents.en: A: Locally, a single Node.js process manages an embedded Postgres and local file storage.
sents.zh: A: 在本地，单个 Node.js 进程管理一个嵌入式 Postgres 和本地文件存储。

sents.en: For production, point it at your own Postgres and deploy however you like.
sents.zh: 在生产环境中，将其指向你自己的 Postgres，并按你喜欢的方式部署。

sents.en: Configure projects, agents, and goals — the agents take care of the rest.
sents.zh: 配置项目、智能体和目标 —— 其余的交给智能体处理。

paragraphs.en: For remote access, use authenticated mode with a private-network bind such as Tailscale, or deploy the persistent server with Docker. See deployment modes and the Docker guide .
paragraphs.zh: 如需远程访问，请使用带私有网络绑定（如 Tailscale）的身份验证模式，或使用 Docker 部署持久化服务器。 请参阅部署模式和 Docker 指南。

sents.en: For remote access, use authenticated mode with a private-network bind such as Tailscale, or deploy the persistent server with Docker.
sents.zh: 如需远程访问，请使用带私有网络绑定（如 Tailscale）的身份验证模式，或使用 Docker 部署持久化服务器。

sents.en: See deployment modes and the Docker guide .
sents.zh: 请参阅部署模式和 Docker 指南。

paragraphs.en: A: Yes. A single deployment can host multiple organizations with company-scoped data and access checks.
paragraphs.zh: A：是的。 单次部署即可承载多个组织，并提供公司级的数据范围与访问校验。

sents.en: A: Yes.
sents.zh: A：是的。

sents.en: A single deployment can host multiple organizations with company-scoped data and access checks.
sents.zh: 单次部署即可承载多个组织，并提供公司级的数据范围与访问校验。

paragraphs.en: Q: How is Paperclip different from agents like OpenClaw or Claude Code?
paragraphs.zh: 问：Paperclip 与 OpenClaw 或 Claude Code 等智能体有何不同？

paragraphs.en: A: Paperclip uses those agents. It orchestrates them into a company — with org charts, budgets, goals, governance, and accountability.
paragraphs.zh: A：回形针（Paperclip）使用这些智能体。 它将这些智能体编排成一家公司——拥有组织架构、预算、目标、治理和问责机制。

sents.en: It orchestrates them into a company — with org charts, budgets, goals, governance, and accountability.
sents.zh: 它将这些智能体编排成一家公司——拥有组织架构、预算、目标、治理和问责机制。

paragraphs.en: Q: Why should I use Paperclip instead of just pointing my OpenClaw to Asana or Trello?
paragraphs.zh: 问：为什么我应该使用 Paperclip，而不是直接把我的 OpenClaw 指向 Asana 或 Trello？

paragraphs.en: A: Agent orchestration has subtleties in how you coordinate who has work checked out, how to maintain sessions, monitoring costs, establishing governance - Paperclip does this for you.
paragraphs.zh: A: 智能体编排在你协调谁领取了工作、如何维护会话、监控成本、建立治理机制等方面有很多微妙之处——Paperclip 会为你处理好这些事情。

paragraphs.en: (Bring-your-own-ticket-system is on the Roadmap)
paragraphs.zh: （自带工单系统功能已在路线图中规划）

paragraphs.en: A: Agents wake for assigned work and follow-up messages. Optional timer heartbeats let them check for work periodically; routines create recurring tasks on their own schedules. You can also connect externally running agents such as OpenClaw. A mention alone does not assign work or wake another agent.
paragraphs.zh: A：智能体在收到分配的工作和后续消息时被唤醒。 可选的定时心跳让它们可以周期性地检查是否有工作；例程会按照自己的日程自动创建重复任务。 你也可以连接外部运行的智能体，例如 OpenClaw。 仅提及并不分配工作或唤醒另一个智能体。

paragraphs.en: Paperclip ships with opt-in OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation for the server (traces only). It activates when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set and supports grpc , http/protobuf , and http/json via the standard OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL env var. @opentelemetry/api is a normal server dependency; the SDK, auto-instrumentation, and exporter packages are optional peer dependencies — install them only if you want tracing. See doc/observability.md for install commands and the full env-var reference.
paragraphs.zh: Paperclip 为服务器提供了可选开启的 OpenTelemetry 自动插桩（仅支持追踪）。 当设置了 OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT 时它会自动激活，并通过标准的 OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL 环境变量支持 grpc、http/protobuf 和 http/json。@opentelemetry/api 是普通的服务器依赖；SDK、自动插桩和导出器包则是可选的对等依赖——只有在你需要追踪功能时才安装它们。 安装命令和完整的环境变量参考请参见 doc/observability.md。

paragraphs.en: Paperclip also ships with opt-in Sentry error monitoring for the server and the browser. Set SENTRY_DSN_FRONTEND to activate it for the browser and SENTRY_DSN_BACKEND to activate it for the server — each variable is optional, and the legacy SENTRY_DSN variable still works as a fallback for either component. The supported server SDK version is @sentry/node@10.71.0 ; it is an optional peer dependency for the server, so install it only if you want error monitoring. The browser SDK, @sentry/browser , is pinned to the same exact version. See doc/observability.md for the install command, the privacy settings, and the full default capture set.
paragraphs.zh: Paperclip 还为服务器和浏览器提供了可选启用（opt-in）的 Sentry 错误监控。 设置 SENTRY_DSN_FRONTEND 可为浏览器启用它，设置 SENTRY_DSN_BACKEND 可为服务器启用它——每个变量都是可选的，旧版 SENTRY_DSN 变量仍可作为任一组件的回退方案。 支持的服务器 SDK 版本为 @sentry/node@10.71.0；它是服务器的可选对等依赖（optional peer dependency），因此只有在你需要错误监控时才安装它。 浏览器 SDK @sentry/browser 则锁定为完全相同的版本。 安装命令、隐私设置以及完整的默认采集集请参见 doc/observability.md。

paragraphs.en: Paperclip collects anonymous usage telemetry to help us understand how the product is used and improve it. No personal information, issue content, prompts, file paths, or secrets are ever collected. Private repository references are hashed with a per-install salt before being sent.
paragraphs.zh: Paperclip 会收集匿名使用遥测数据，以帮助我们了解产品的使用方式并加以改进。 我们绝不会收集任何个人信息、议题内容、提示词、文件路径或密钥。 私有仓库引用会在发送前使用每次安装生成的盐值进行哈希处理。

paragraphs.en: Contributors changing emitted telemetry events should follow the Telemetry Data Contract . For proposed first-party events that are not in the generated contract yet, follow Telemetry Workflow .
